proves.claim: a seat whose built item is submitted, in the gate or in review is not moved to another lane, and the idle line names the item.

moves.io-selection.gate-item-pins-lane.why: A seat moved away from the lane its submitted item was built in could not fix that item's files when it was rejected, because the pre-commit hook enforces the seat's lane (#12019).

proves.claim: once the item lands or is released, the same seat is moved to the lane with work as before.

moves.io-selection.landed-item-frees-lan.why: The hold on the lane must end with the item, or a seat would never move again (#12019).
